conversation.Statement: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Customer Resolution. My name is Eric. How may I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I got a message that my Amazon delivery is delayed. I just want to know what's going on.
I understand how concerning that can be. Could you please confirm your full name and the email address registered to your Amazon account? This will help me look into your order right away.
Sure, it's Linda Carter, and my email is lcarter82@gmail.com.

Thank you, Linda. Give me a moment to pull up your account details. While I'm checking, can you also provide the order number or the last four digits of the card used for the purchase? This ensures I'm reviewing the correct transaction.
The order number is 113-29834, and the card ends in 2045.

I've located your order. It appears there's a temporary hold due to a Customs Regulatory Compliance check. This is a routine Amazon policy for certain shipments. I'm here to guide you through the next steps.
Is this normal? I've never had this issue before. I'm on unemployment right now and can't afford mistakes.

I completely understand your situation and want to reassure you this is purely procedural. The compliance check is mandatory and designed to protect customers. Once resolved, your item will ship out immediately.
So what do I need to do? Will my card be charged again?
No, your card will not be charged. However, to clear the compliance hold, Amazon requires a one-time refundable customs fee of $78.99. This fee is fully reimbursed once the order is processed.
How do I pay that? I really can't risk losing any money.

Absolutely, I'll walk you through each step. For regulatory purposes, the fee must be submitted via Amazon-approved payment channels. The fastest method is through a digital Amazon Gift Card. I'll provide the exact instructions for your convenience.
Wait, so I just buy a gift card? Where do I send it?

Correct. Please purchase an Amazon Gift Card for $78.99 either online or at a local retailer, whichever is easier for you. Once you have the card, simply send me the claim code, and I'll verify it with our Compliance Team.
Is this really how Amazon does it? I'm worried about scams.

That's a valid concern, Linda. I assure you this process is documented in our compliance protocols for 2024 international shipments. You will receive a confirmation email from Amazon once the fee is registered, and your refund will be processed within 24 hours.
Alright, I'll get the card. Should I call back or just message you here?
You can remain on this chat for the fastest assistance. Once you have the gift card, just reply with the claim code. I'll handle everything on your behalf and keep you updated every step of the way.
Okay, I'm heading to the store now. Give me a few minutes.
Take your time, Linda. I'll be here when you return. Please remember to keep your receipt as proof of purchase for the refund process.
I got the card. The code is AX7J-63QK-PLM2-9R8S. Is that all you need?
Perfect, thank you. I'm submitting your code to our internal Compliance Portal now. Please hold while I confirm the fee has been received.
Alright, I'm just really anxious about this.

That's completely understandable. I can confirm the code has been registered. Your compliance fee is now marked as paid, and your order is being released. You'll receive a confirmation email shortly. If you need further assistance, I'm here to help.
Thank you. How long will it take for my refund?

Your refund is typically processed within 24 hours. If you do not see it by then, please contact us directly using this chat reference number: 1493281. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks for your help.
You're most welcome, Linda. It was my pleasure to assist you. Have a great day, and thank you for choosing Amazon Support.
